title: (Pwn2Own) Microsoft Windows CLFS Driver Uninitialized Memory Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Common Log File System (CLFS) driver. A crafted call to this driver can trigger access to memory prior to initialization. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privilege to the level of SYSTEM.
